overview: The CC Energy & Environment Committee met to receive municipal sustainability updates, discuss proposed waste collection changes, and assign tracking tasks for the city's Climate Action Plan. The committee voted to endorse a letter addressing black plastic takeout containers and agreed to draft advocacy regarding proposed state Mass Save cuts.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Administrative Items
items.summary: The committee approved the previous meeting minutes and discussed establishing a direct committee email list for future communications.

items.title: City Updates and Mass Save Legislation
items.summary: Staff presented updates on grants, smart meter installations, and upcoming events, and the committee agreed to draft a letter to state senators opposing proposed Mass Save budget cuts.

items.title: Black Plastic Reduction Memo
items.summary: The committee voted to approve an outreach memo advising food establishments against using black plastic containers, pending added references and city official review.

items.title: Pay-As-You-Throw Waste Management Discussion
items.summary: Members discussed proposed pay-as-you-throw trash collection models, addressing rodent management, overflow bin options, pet waste, and seasonal pickup schedules.

items.title: Climate Action Plan Monitoring
items.summary: The committee reviewed the Climate Action Plan tracking sheet, with individual members volunteering to collect updates on specific energy, building, and stormwater strategies.
